missionPremise: CTX-HAYS-SPLIT dispatch (2026-09-09): the prior CTX-HAYS close handed the operator a ruling on Hays's ~37,510-account 2025-to-2026 gap (recordRetirement via CTX-RETIRE) that treated the gap as one population, but the same close's own finding shows cad_property 48209 tax_year=2025 has two source lineages (hays-export2.zip, genuine CAD; stratmap25-landparcels_48209_lp.zip, a non-CAD geometry coverage fallback applied 2026-08-25 by P-78). recordRetirement asserts an account left the roll -- honest for a genuine CAD dropout, a fabricated claim for a StratMap geometry row that was never an appraisal account. This lane's mission is to split the absent population by lineage, determine whether source_file (overwritten in place by P-78 for updated rows) can still support that split, find a field that can if not, and recommend -- not implement -- the honest absence state per resulting population.
completionPredicate: A stranger can evaluate this done by: (1) the absent population (present@2025, absent@2026, county 48209) is counted directly via anti-join and reported with its full rule (38444 total); (2) grouped by current source_file, and that grouping is shown, from code and from independent arithmetic, to conflate two different kinds of row because P-78 overwrote source_file unconditionally on every touched row; (3) a field that survives the overwrite (assessed_value) is identified, calibrated against a known-pure reference lineage before being trusted, and applied to recover the true split (384 genuine-CAD-lineage absent / 38060 geometry-only absent); (4) a control run against a genuinely single-lineage county confirms the instrument does not manufacture a split where none exists, and any deviation between the dispatch's named control county and its live state is reported rather than silently worked around; (5) the pre-registered falsifier is stated before the split runs and its outcome (fired or not) is reported plainly; (6) a one-sentence honest-absence-state recommendation is given per resulting population, recommending only, with no recordRetirement or other absence state written to any row; (7) a stranger reading only this close (or the companion finding doc) can act on the ruling without reading any prior lane's close.

lessons: A merge's ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE can overwrite a row's own provenance column (source_file/source_vintage) unconditionally even while coalescing every substantive attribute field -- p78Merge.ts does exactly this. Any future lineage-archaeology on a county that has been through more than one apply at the same tax_year should assume the provenance column itself is untrustworthy and look for a field the newer source structurally cannot populate (here: assessed_value, because StratMap/TxGIO never carries one) rather than trusting source_file as a partition. This generalizes the lesson the parent CTX-HAYS close already flagged about source_file being 'last writer, not full provenance' -- this lane found the specific field that survives it for this merge.

A 'single-vintage' sweep (distinct tax_years per county) is not the same claim as a 'single-lineage' sweep (distinct source_files within a vintage) -- Bastrop passed the first and failed the second, and nothing before this lane had checked the second dimension. Any future per-county lineage audit should check both.

assessed_value's calibration (100% populated in the known-pure reference lineage, both overall and in its absent subset) is specific to Hays/Caldwell's CAD export shape; a different CAD vendor or a county with legitimately null assessed values on some real accounts (e.g. certain exempt classes) would need its own baseline check before reusing this exact field as a recovery signal elsewhere.
deadEnds: exemption_codes and living_area_sqft were checked as alternative recovery fields alongside assessed_value; both are legitimately sparse even in the known-pure reference lineage (60.6% and 71.2% populated respectively, not 100%), so a NULL on either does not imply 'never CAD' -- they are not usable as the primary discriminator, only as a (redundant, in this case) secondary check.
